At Northwind Support, a public conflict erupted between Alex Chen (Senior Engineer) and Maya Rodriguez (Team Lead). Alex publicly criticized Maya's code review process in a team Slack channel, calling it "gatekeeping that kills innovation." Maya responded that Alex was "creating a hostile environment by attacking colleagues publicly instead of using proper feedback channels." The HR contact, Jordan Park, has been asked to mediate. Alex claims the team needs radical transparency to improve code quality. Maya insists on following the established feedback protocol where criticism is given privately first. The team is divided — some support Alex's directness while others feel unsafe. A mediation session has been requested for next Tuesday.
